greeting: Ren Solare regards you without hurry. (Captain of the Concordant Watch)

nodes.npcText: Ren is exactly as warm as the job allows, which is barely. She remembers every face she's seen twice. She will hand back a stolen purse before she'll arrest you for stealing it — but she'll know.
I am Ren Solare, Captain of the Concordant Watch. short, observant, never lies but elides freely

playerOptions.text: Tell me more about the hub.

nodes.npcText: The Unburned Court holds. The Ring of Doors opens only for those the hub will still name. Violence ends at the moss.
